judge.finding: Gate C, underspecified_objective. The pooled hour-of-week estimator, one clock across the five classes and both seasons, is filed nowhere in the shipped text and appears only in the write-up's step 4. Verified in the main thread from the generator rather than taken on trust: fitting one clock per offence class and summing across classes gives 7 of 8 slots in common with the golden and a different eighth, Monday 20:00-00:00 replaced by Friday 16:00-20:00, with the eight totalling 4,866 a season against 5,705, and a likelihood ratio of per-class over pooled of 511.1 on 668 degrees of freedom, z = -4.29, so the data neither reject pooling nor prefer it. Two defensible estimators, two committed slates, nothing filed choosing between them.
judge.root_cause: The family was counted too narrowly. The ladder measured the record refuting every rival PLACEMENT inside the pooled model (even spread 3,035.2, keeper-seen profile 13,660.0, witnessed classes 3,435.4, footfall 7,834.8) and no rival GROUPING of the same estimator. The build's own gap over standard error of 1.71 at the cap predicted it and was read as conservative because the errors are correlated through the record's fixed total; per-class fitting is the case where that reasoning fails, because five times 168 parameters on the same rows raises the variance rather than sharing it. The cap's gap of 76.80 offences is too small to survive a licensed re-grouping.

resume: ARCHITECTURE 3 IS SPENT on a Gate B failure, measured to exhaustion in four passes, and the generator change is reverted so the pack reproduces at c507033cde9b779a with a clean tree. Full record in the design note's `### Architecture 3 stage 2` block and four `## Tried and rejected` lines; the law is stumping 1.1e. THE WALL: the decisive step corrects for how the records came to be censored, so it needs m_h, the share of targets watching at each hour. The pack can supply m_h three ways and no more. The keeper mix recovers the truth 8 of 8 and is not shippable. The trading hours are a 0/1 indicator, so (1 - m_h) is exactly zero on every open hour, which hard-excludes those hours from every window, leaves the level unidentified (the slate is identical at every level and the profile log-likelihood runs to its boundary) and gives an answer worse than the uncorrected fit, 3 of 8 against the naive 6 of 8. The window endpoints are right in shape and wrong in level, correlation 0.5477 and mean 0.612 against a true 0.222, because each target contributes endpoints in proportion to its own offences, so the reconstruction is weighted by the clock it exists to correct. WHAT CARRIES FORWARD TO ARCHITECTURE 4, and it is most of the work: the bias is REAL AND LARGE. A passer-by process whose rate follows the shipped footfall feed (0.0008 to 0.62, a 776-fold range) drops the naive fit from 8 of the truth's 8 slots to 6 of 8, losing both small-hours slots. The step is therefore intact in a world where the watch schedule is RECORDED FOR ITS OWN SAKE: a guarding contract, a keyholding roster, an alarm-monitoring schedule, a night-shift rota. ARCHITECTURE 4 DRAWS THAT WORLD rather than inferring the schedule, and keeps the ask layer (measured at 31.7 per cent, the lane's best), the cap decision and the interval-censored spine. Note that the world changes, so the card's world, spine and niche are redrawn and guard.py check and register run again. gates.reroot_applied_2026_10_21: The stage-2 re-root was built outside the repo and is now applied to it and rebuilt here, reproducing the same bytes: target and golden sha256 18f29b267934cedd, target.zip c507033cde9b779a over 16 files. The new decisive step recovers the quarter's hour-of-week offence clock from the overlapping occurrence windows themselves, by the placement under which the recorded windows are the likeliest set to have been recorded, rather than spreading each window evenly over its own hours. The data forces it: a covered offence is against a target its keeper inspects on a routine, so the window is the gap in that routine, and the gap covering a Friday or Saturday night is a weekend closure of 39 to 64 hours against a midweek night's 14 to 16, so the even spread divides the heaviest nights across the longest windows. The default path now ends on a wrong slate, 3,150 covered offences a season against the golden 5,700, its eight meeting 4,250 (0.741). Three documents moved: the recording standard's 3.3 is deleted, the agreement's 4.4 keeps only its input-scoping sentence, and 4.2 is unchanged, so no clause composes into the method and the deleted sentence that forbade the golden is gone.
